200.description: Server-Sent Events stream. A normal lifetime close may reconnect with the last event id; Last-Event-ID takes precedence over after. If a control event reports ROOM_SCOPE_CHANGED, do not resume at the old cursor: resynchronize room access and replay from the retained floor. The id-less control frame is {"error":{"code":"CODE"}} and has no message field.
